hotels.title: Maldives Private Pool Oceanfront Escape with 12 Restaurants & Bars
hotels.description: On a private island in the North Malé Atoll, this luxury retreat pairs contemporary Maldivian design with a spectacular lagoon and powder-soft sands. Villas and residences span the shoreline and overwater boardwalks with private pools and uninterrupted views across the Indian Ocean. Dining unfolds across nine restaurants and three bars, from fire-led plates at The Restaurant to Japanese flavours at Mar-Umi. The spa offers overwater treatment rooms and a curated menu of massages and rituals. Surf breaks and snorkelling sites sit close by, with manta rays and reef fish frequenting nearby channels.
